title: SPECIAL: The Banking Crisis with Edward Chancellor
summary: We discuss the common thread across the financial stresses around the world is rising interest rates to tackle inflation. Are the events with Credit Suisse and the US banks the start of a broader financial crisis? How can the world tackle its debt and what does it mean for commodities?
